title: Occupancy and Residency Certification: Anchor Date of a Completed Cycle by Channel of the Last Signature
content:
The **anchor date** of a completed certification cycle on an Occupancy and Residency Certification profile turns on the channel of the last signature — the certification recorded under the open cycle with the latest standing date — and, for a mailed signature, on when its form was received:

| Last signature | Anchor date |
|---|---|
| came by mail, and its form was received no more than 30 calendar days after the signature's standing date | the form's receipt date — the day the servicer held the last required signature |
| came by mail, and its form was received later than that | the date the cycle is completed |
| came by any other channel | the last signature's standing date |

The form's receipt date is the date the form was received, a form received before the signature's standing date counting as received on it.

*Boundary (hypothetical).* A mailed form received on the 30th day after the standing date gives its receipt date; on the 31st day, the completion date itself.
